title: The Last Address
purpose: Adrian finds Mara's abandoned courier ledger and chooses to preserve her evidence.

stages.objective: Meet Dante at Cross Motor Works.
stages.speaker: Dante
stages.line: Mara left her car here. The ledger is in warehouse nine. Someone else is looking for it.

stages.objective: Drive the Sable GT to bonded storage.
stages.speaker: Adrian
stages.line: Same docks. Different owners. I'll bring back what she found.

stages.objective: Recover Mara's ledger at warehouse nine.
stages.speaker: Mara's note
stages.line: The payments lead to Blackwater. Elena knows the names. Trust the evidence, Adrian.

stages.objective: Escape security and lose the search.
stages.speaker: Elena
stages.line: You have her ledger? Then keep moving. The harbor cameras are already looking for you.

stages.speaker: Dante
stages.line: I'll hide the car. You find Elena. Whatever Mara found, we finish it together.

failure: Player health depleted; restore last checkpoint.
assets: Clothed CC0 human with rig and source walk/run; project-authored modeled GLB harbor and sedan; CC0 asphalt/concrete PBR maps; original synthesized audio. Greeting/closing dialogue uses draft eSpeak NG formant-synthesized voices and amplitude jaw fallback. Other mission/radio lines remain text.
